_note: Ukrainian; see topbar.json and docs/translating.md. Settings › AI assistants (MCP), ШІ-помічники: how much an assistant may do (Вимкнено, Підготовка, Підготовка й керування екранами), one tile per company (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) and the other apps under Other apps, each with Add, Replace, Remove and Copy setup. An assistant is a помічник (masculine); an app is a програма, as in Apple's Ukrainian. App and company names (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Gemini, Grok Build), MCP, mcpServers and file names are names and stay as they are; {app}, {apps} and {assistant} are those names, so the sentences are built not to decline them. What Copy setup copies is written to the assistant and stays English. Copy setup is «Скопіювати вказівки» (copy the instructions), not «Скопіювати налаштування»: the key keeps its words' width in a tile as narrow as 170 points.
